ui.a963bb6108f4: Repetier: @pause requests an operator tool change through Repetier-Host; it does not select a tool automatically. M84 releases motors and may lose the reference. Check fixtures, origin and height before resuming; the preview does not simulate this loss.

ui.ad72fab202c4: Dwell: interface time remains in seconds; G4 P is emitted in milliseconds, including in IN. Native feed is per minute, without G94.
ui.1a5bfef7cb45: Manual tool change: three M0 pauses per tool. Between them, a commanded move to Z0 uses the tool's Feed Z and returns to Tool change Z; G90 is restored before vertical moves. This is not probing or automatic contact detection.

preferences.numbers.units.help:
Starting unit for an empty project and new objects.

Reference: opened files and projects retain their own units. This choice does not convert existing objects and takes effect the next time the application opens.
preferences.numbers.precision.help:
Integer from 2 to 16. The default is 4 for both units, as in Python.

Result: sets decimal places in coordinate readouts, measurements and object tables. Does not round geometry or parameters used to generate files. Takes effect after reopening the application.
preferences.numbers.scope: Used in status-bar and HUD coordinates, measurements and object aperture/tool tables. Export formats and values entered in machining fields are independent.
preferences.numbers.apply.help: Validates and saves this section. Initial units and precision change on the next startup. Does not change the current project or G-code format.
preferences.numbers.reset.help: Prepares MM and four decimal places for both units, matching Python defaults. Use Apply and save to confirm.
preferences.numbers.reset: Defaults prepared: MM and four decimal places. Apply to save.
preferences.numbers.restart: Settings saved. Reopen the application to use the new initial units and precision.
